name: Context 30
definition: Context in which the card payment transaction is performed.

CardDataEntryMode.name: Card Data Entry Mode
CardDataEntryMode.definition: Entry mode of the card data for the transaction, P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

QRCodePresentmentMode.name: QR Code Presentment Mode
QRCodePresentmentMode.definition: Method used to present a QR Code at the point of service. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction in accordance with ISO 18245.

MerchantCategorySpecificData.name: Merchant Category Specific Data
MerchantCategorySpecificData.definition: Further details about the merchant that is used in with the merchant category code (MCC) for the particular purchase.

OtherMerchantCategory.name: Other Merchant Category
OtherMerchantCategory.definition: Other merchant category assigned by local or national scheme.

CardPresent.name: Card Present
CardPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated by a card physically present or not.||True: Card physically present during the transaction|False: Card physically absent during the transaction.

CardholderPresent.name: Cardholder Present
CardholderPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated in presence of the cardholder or not.||True: Cardholder present during the transaction|False: Cardholder absent during the transaction.

CardholderActivated.name: Cardholder Activated
CardholderActivated.definition: Indicates whether the automated device was operated solely by the cardholder or not (for example, vending machine, automated fuel dispenser, ATM, kiosk, etc.).||True: Device operated solely by the cardholder|False: Device not operated solely by the cardholder.

TransponderInitiated.name: Transponder Initiated
TransponderInitiated.definition: Transaction initiated through a transponder or not.|True: Transaction initiated through a transponder.|False: Transaction not initiated through a transponder.

Attended.name: Attended
Attended.definition: Card acceptor representative in attendance at the point of service during the transaction.|When an acceptor’s terminal is semi-attended (for example, multiple terminals supervised by a single clerk), it will be identified as ‘attended’.||True: Attended transaction at the terminal|False: Non-attended transaction at the terminal

UnattendedLevelCategory.name: Unattended Level Category
UnattendedLevelCategory.definition: Transaction category level on an unattended terminal.

ECommerce.name: E Commerce
ECommerce.definition: Indicates whether the point of service is an e-commerce one or not:|True: e-commerce |False: non e-commerce |Default: False

ECommerceIndicatorProposed.name: E Commerce Indicator Proposed
ECommerceIndicatorProposed.definition: Contains the proposed level of security of e-commerce transaction.

ECommerceIndicatorApplied.name: E Commerce Indicator Applied
ECommerceIndicatorApplied.definition: Contains the applied level of security of e-commerce transaction.

MOTOCode.name: MOTO Code
MOTOCode.definition: A code that identifies the type of MOTO transaction.

NoShow.name: No Show
NoShow.definition: Indicates that the cardholder failed to arrive at the property and was therefore charged a no-show fee; property was not actually rented.

DelayedAuthorisation.name: Delayed Authorisation
DelayedAuthorisation.definition: Indicates whether the authorisation was delayed due to an on-board initiated transaction.||True: The authorisation was delayed|False: The authorisation was not delayed

LatePresentment.name: Late Presentment
LatePresentment.definition: Indicates a late presentment as defined by each specific implementation.|True: Transaction was presented late|False: Transaction was not presented late|Default: False

DeferredDelivery.name: Deferred Delivery
DeferredDelivery.definition: Indicates a deferred delivery as defined by each specific implementation.||True: deferred delivery.|False: Delivery is not identified as deferred.|Default: False.

SplitPayment.name: Split Payment
SplitPayment.definition: Also referred to as split tender. Indicates whether the payment transaction is a partial payment of the sale transaction.|True: Partial payment of a sale transaction|False: Not a partial payment of a sale transaction.

PartialApprovalSupported.name: Partial Approval Supported
PartialApprovalSupported.definition: Indicates whether the point of service supports partial approval or not.|True: partial approval is supported|False: partial approval is not supported

SecurityCharacteristics.name: Security Characteristics
SecurityCharacteristics.definition: Security characteristics of the communication link in the card acceptance process. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

StorageLocation.name: Storage Location
StorageLocation.definition: Storage location of payment credential (for example, Acceptor or third party wallet).

AuthenticationOutage.name: Authentication Outage
AuthenticationOutage.definition: Indicates that the consumer authentication process is temporarily unavailable in the acceptance, acquirer or agent environment for this request.  It does not indicate an outage in the issuer processing domain (including agents acting on behalf of the issuer).

PaymentCredentialMerchantRelationship.name: Payment Credential Merchant Relationship
PaymentCredentialMerchantRelationship.definition: Indicates the relationship between payment credential and merchant.

CaptureDate.name: Capture Date
CaptureDate.definition: Date the transaction was completed and captured.|ISO 8583 bit 17

DateAnticipated.name: Date Anticipated
DateAnticipated.definition: The date on which the sale or purchase is expected to occur.

SaleReferenceNumber.name: Sale Reference Number
SaleReferenceNumber.definition: Identify a sale transaction assigned by the sale system.

GoodsAndServicesSubType.name: Goods And Services Sub Type
GoodsAndServicesSubType.definition: Sub type of goods and/or services. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

GoodAndServiceDeliveryChannel.name: Good And Service Delivery Channel
GoodAndServiceDeliveryChannel.definition: Code that specifies the good or service delivery channel.

GoodAndServiceDeliverySchedule.name: Good And Service Delivery Schedule
GoodAndServiceDeliverySchedule.definition: Code that specifies the good or service delivery schedule.P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

ReceiptRequest.name: Receipt Request
ReceiptRequest.definition: Indicates whether a receipt from the goods or services provider was requested.|True: Receipt requested|False: Receipt not requested.

ReceiptType.name: Receipt Type
ReceiptType.definition: Type of receipt requested or communication channel used.

ReceiptDestination.name: Receipt Destination
ReceiptDestination.definition: Destination of the receipt (for example, e-mail address, SMS number, etc.).

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
